title: Company Concert: Q3 Focus Plan & Town Meeting Rehearsal (v0.1)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working deck and runbook for the company-wide Q3 focus alignment and the associated town meeting rehearsal. Treat as a lightweight, operational plan — not final messaging. Goal is to converge on crisp, measurable company OKRs and a 35-minute town meeting that primes teams for the quarter.

High-level objective for the quarter (draft):
- Make inference predictable and 2x more cost-efficient for mid-market customers on average.
- Signal: 20% reduction in host API cost per 1k tokens on common workloads; Dedicated adoption +30% QoQ.

Draft company OKRs (v0.1)
Objective A: Reduce unit inference cost while preserving latency and quality
- KR A1: Average hosted API cost-per-1k tokens down 20% on top 5 production prompts (by 2025-09-30)
- KR A2: Deploy model quantization and batching playbooks to customers; 12 customers adopt recommended profile
- KR A3: Introduce automatic KV/prefix caching for 3 high-volume enterprise routes with <5% accuracy delta

Objective B: Improve reliability and predictable SLOs across deployment modes
- KR B1: Achieve 99.9% uptime on Dedicated pools across 3 major regions
- KR B2: Mean 95th percentile latency for 1024-token generation <250ms on Dedicated SLO routes
- KR B3: Private deployment on-prem pilot with 2 regulated customers, compliance checklist green

Objective C: Developer velocity & adoption
- KR C1: Developer onboarding time (first successful call to meaningful result) <30 minutes for 80% of signups
- KR C2: Launch two new quickstart templates demonstrating cost-optimized prompts and SDK patterns
- KR C3: Improve retention of free-credit cohort: 25% convert to paid within 60 days

Success signals (qualitative + quantitative)
- Reduced token spend for typical product integration demo flows (trackable in Console analytics)
- Customer testimonials citing predictable cost/latency after migration to Dedicated
- Fewer post-deploy incidents for customer rollouts (SRE target: -30% incident rate QoQ)

Town meeting ("Town Meeting" = company-wide quarter kickoff) run of show — 35 minutes total
- 0:00–0:03 Opening (CEO) — three-sentence north star for Q3; one explicit ask to managers
- 0:03–0:10 Product & Platform highlights (Head of Product + Head of Engineering) — demo: new batching/quantization visible in Console
- 0:10–0:16 Customer & GTM snapshot (GTM lead) — top 3 customer wins and a friction story we fixed
- 0:16–0:22 Operational commitments (SRE/Infra) — Dedicated SLOs and new runbook changes
- 0:22–0:28 People & hiring cadence (People ops) — hiring priorities and manager actions for onboarding
- 0:28–0:33 Quick QA (pre-submitted + upvoted questions) — moderated by comms
- 0:33–0:35 Closing call-to-action (Executive ask + 2-week next steps)

Prep checklist for speakers
- Slide limits: Max 1 slide per speaker segment (keep to two if demo is needed)
- Demo readiness: console metrics to show before/after numbers; warm caches for demo tenants
- Bullets to rehearse: headline, why it matters (one sentence), measurable ask for managers

Rehearsal plan & timeline
- Wed 6/18: Draft slides due to comms (owners above)
- Fri 6/20: Dry run w/ execs (30m) — identify timing and handoffs
- Mon 6/23: Tech dry run (demo & network) w/ SRE and infra (15m)
- Tue 6/24: Final run-through with messaging owner and comms (25m)

Key messages to land (single-line soundbites)
- "Q3 is about making inference cost a predictable, engineering-leveraged advantage for our customers."
- "We will measure success by real unit economics and the reliability customers feel in production."
- "Managers: enable your teams with the new quickstart kit and report blockers in the weekly ops sync."

Risks & mitigations (short list)
- Risk: Demo flake under live scale -> Mitigation: pre-generate traces and videos; have fallback static screenshots
- Risk: OKRs feel too infra-heavy to PMs -> Mitigation: pair infra KRs with explicit product KRs and customer outcomes
- Risk: Messaging overload for external partners -> Mitigation: two-tier comms: internal (full detail), customer-facing (top-line benefits only)

Dependencies & open asks (owners)
- Console metrics slice for top 5 prompts (Owner: Ethan Liu) — blocker: instrumentation PR GH#114
- Dedicated capacity SLA wording for public docs (Owner: Priya Shah) — deliverable: legal review by 6/30
- Quickstart templates (Owner: Rohan Patel) — need 2 sample apps and docs by 7/15

Post-town follow-up plan
- 48 hours: release executive summary email to all teams with clear 2-week manager asks (owner: comms)
- 2 weeks: cross-team intake for blockers and resource requests; use intake board (JIRA: GTM-228)
- 6 weeks: first health check and OKR cadence check-in (lead: product ops)

Action items (immediate)
- Avery: collect final single-sentence asks from all speakers by 6/16
- Rohan: draft two quickstart templates skeletons; link to GH PR for review by 6/20
- Ethan: provide metrics slice export and demo checklist by 6/20
- Priya: draft Dedicated SLA blurb and compliance checklist by 6/25

Notes to self / friction points to track in rehearsal
- Keep CEO opener to a single line about customer outcomes; avoid metric overload
- Ensure product demo highlights both cost and latency improvements in the same view
- Prepare one 15-second anecdote from a real customer reflecting reliability improvements

Conversation fragments / open questions (for next sync)
- Should we fold the Private deployment pilot update into the product segment or infra segment?
- Do managers need a separate manager-only rehearsal slot the week after the town meeting?
- Which 5 prompts are canonical for downstream cost tracking? (suggestions: chat reply, summarization 512, long-form summarization 1024, reranking, semantic search embed)

Appendix: quick links and references (working)

- Demo instrumentation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/114
- Previous quarter summary: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/COM/Q2+Operational+Review
